ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   C. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.
